name: stench
desc:
Any creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s Stench for 24 hours.
Any creature that starts its turn within 5 ft. of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a Constitution saving throw.
